lesson_title: Profit, Discount and the Cost of a Loan
hook_text: Borrow R5 000 at 12%. Do you pay back R5 600? Think again.
clip_script: Thabo borrows R5 000 at twelve percent simple interest per year for three years. Interest for one year: twelve percent of R5 000, which is R600. For three years: three times R600, R1 800. The total amount he must repay is principal plus interest: R5 000 plus R1 800, R6 800.
visual_style: A fridge with a R5 000 price tag; three yearly coin stacks of R600 pile up beside it; a final receipt shows R6 800.
pacing: Quick setup, one year then three years, pause on the total.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to see how a spaza shop works out profit, discount and budgets.
